svg.text: 400 x 300 window in the middle (the chamber opening).

svg.text: Four latch tabs 41 wide x 40 tall stand out from the sides,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 95 above and 95 below the window's centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark each latch's screw holes through the latch; drill 3 mm.
